fields.description: One app as it appears on the Meta dashboard. Every access token is issued by exactly one app, so each lead source names the app its token came from.
fields.label: Meta App

fields.description: The app's name on the Meta dashboard, used only to recognise it in a list.
fields.label: App Name

fields.description: The numeric App ID from the Meta dashboard. It is not a secret.
fields.label: App ID

fields.description: The App Secret from the same dashboard, stored encrypted. Without it, a pasted token expires within the hour.
fields.label: App Secret

fields.description: The settings used when Meta is called for this app. They are held per app, so one app can be moved to a newer version and watched while the others stay.
fields.label: Facebook Graph API

fields.description: The version of Meta's interface used for this app. A retired version quietly stops returning leads, so move one app at a time and watch its next run.
fields.label: Graph API Version

fields.description: The number of leads fetched in one call. It does not cap the total - every new lead is still collected; only the number of round trips changes.
fields.label: Leads Fetched Per Request
